notes:
New in this release (the changes since 0.5.0 are listed below it):

- **Upscale tells you how long it takes before it starts**: when it will run longer than about a minute, a
  question shows the estimate and whether it runs on the GPU or CPU. **Cancel** stops it at any time and the
  image stays unchanged. First run on a computer is a rough estimate; after that it uses the measured speed.
- **While it runs**, the status bar shows the time left, e.g. "Upscaling… 40 % · about 2 min left".

- **Trim to content** and **Crop…** in Preparation (Image card and Edit menu): the image is cut down to what is
  printed, so the print width is the width of the design. Brush strokes follow; Ctrl+Z undoes one step,
  **Back to the original** undoes all of them (Upscale included).
- Closing or opening another file now also asks about unsaved changes to a plain image (not only to a project)
  and offers to save them as a project.
- Vynfera trims transparent margins automatically – the width you type is the width of what is cut.
- **Upscale and AI cut-out use the graphics card** (DirectML, any DirectX 12 GPU) when there is one – much
  faster (about 2.5× on an Intel Iris Xe laptop). A stronger card gets bigger tiles automatically, and on laptops with two graphics
  chips the faster one is used. Without a usable GPU they run on the processor as before. The status bar shows
  GPU or CPU.
- **Zoom slider** in the status bar of every module; the progress bar only appears while Applika is working.
- **Tab** (View → Show / hide panels) hides the side panels to give the image the whole window.
- The same header (icon, name, version, INFERA M) in every module; Gang sheet has its own icon.
